name: Yokohama (Aomori, Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Yokohama town emblem in yellow and red: a yellow disc bearing a red stylised character with a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Yokohama, a town in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in September 1970.

features.role: Yokohama town emblem — a yellow disc bearing a red stylised character with a ring
